style: Bright rounded 2D preschool animation with clean silhouettes, expressive faces, gentle squash-and-stretch and African place cues grounded in everyday life rather than stereotypes.
camera: Prefer readable two-shots and wides for learning beats.
Use close-ups for repetition and emotional cues.
Avoid frantic cuts; preschool comprehension comes first.
safety: Road/travel scenes require clear adult-safe framing.
Do not present generic African motifs as belonging to one culture without review.
